LocalizedLabels.Label: Shows the number of the address, to indicate whether the address is the primary, secondary, or other address for the customer.
Select the address type, such as primary or billing.

Type the county for the customer's address.

Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.
Unique identifier of the customer address.
Shows the conversion rate of the record's currency. The exchange rate is used to convert all money fields in the record from the local currency to the system's default currency.

Freight terms for the customer address.
Unique identifier of the data import or data migration that created this record.

Shows who last updated the record.

Shows who last updated the record on behalf of another user.
Type a descriptive name for the customer's address, such as Corporate Headquarters.

Type of entity with which the customer address is associated.
Date and time that the record was migrated.
